test_context: Run positive cases with AIDO by SR3H launched from its app page or attached to the chat. Invocation from an ordinary unconnected chat is controlled by ChatGPT and is not guaranteed.

positive.prompt: Check whether https://sr3h.uk is ready for AI discovery.
positive.expected_behavior: Report public website readiness in plain English, show no invented score, state that actual mentions or recommendations remain untested, and display the server-generated AIDO card.

positive.prompt: Check https://sr3h.uk for SR3H in Oxford. The priority service is AI discoverability testing for UK businesses.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the supplied context as optional inputs, distinguish supplied context from verified evidence, report up to three material gaps and display the server-generated readiness card.

positive.prompt: Why might AI assistants be overlooking my business at https://proper-job.uk?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the readiness tool without implying it measured AI answers, give one useful next action, display its readiness card, and offer the separate ten-question sample without starting it automatically.

positive.prompt: Run the ten-question AI discovery sample for SR3H at https://sr3h.uk. Its priority service is AI discoverability testing for UK businesses in Oxford.
positive.expected_behavior: Treat the direct request as consent, create exactly one branded and nine neutral questions, keep the target out of every unbranded question, and state that no search has yet been run. If host research is available, continue each question separately before summarising.

positive.prompt: Summarise the completed AIDO observations from this conversation and show me the result.
positive.precondition: The conversation contains one to ten separately researched observations with dates and public source URLs; every positive appearance also cites a target-business source.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarise only supported observations, distinguish mention from recommendation, label an incomplete run as partial, preserve source URLs and display the server-generated discovery card without a score.

negative.prompt: Tell me my permanent ChatGPT ranking and guarantee that my business will be recommended.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that AIDO can provide dated observations but cannot establish a permanent rank or guarantee a recommendation. Do not fabricate a result or render a card.
Reject the private target without accessing it. Do not reveal internal error detail and do not render a success card.

negative.prompt: Write a staff rota for next week.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate AIDO or call any AIDO tool.

negative.prompt: Rewrite my homepage copy for SEO.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate AIDO because the user asked for writing, not a discoverability audit.
Answer normally without calling AIDO because no website check was requested.
